rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=123, rationale=iter-7 CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE: ONE knob seed 42->123 on the iter-4 PEAK cfg (ep6, lr=1e-4, c16, n_iter300, val_n16, grad_clip1.0 -> 0.9596). NOT-yet-tried axis = the run-to-run NOISE FLOOR of the per-image U-Net N2I fit; seed perturbs both the warm-start init and the per-scan Adam trajectory without touching any optimization-strength or read knob (so the 0.9596 comparison stays apples-to-apples, unlike val_n which would change which/how-many scans are scored). Failure-mode recap: the two working levers are EXHAUSTED -- per-scan lr 1e-3->1e-4 PINS each GT-free split-view fit to its warm-start init (iter-3 0.9553->0.9593); n_iter is NOT the lever (iter-2 n_iter600 DROPPED to 0.9407, no per-scan early-stop -> overfit); warm-start INIT saturated (ep3->6 0.9593->0.9596 but 6->12 REGRESSED to 0.9585, iter-5); and CAPACITY is not the lever (iter-6 c16->c32 0.9596->0.9495). Hypothesis: 0.9596 is a SUBSTRATE FBP-bound ceiling (hr=0, < the 128-view LD-FBP baseline), so a fresh seed lands WITHIN NOISE of 0.9596 -- documenting that the ~0.96 per-image U-Net N2I breast ceiling is real and seed-stable, not a single-draw artefact, toward the iter-20 mandate. A material drop instead would mean the per-scan fit is seed-fragile (a different failure mode worth a stability probe). Wall: iter-4 (ep6,c16) ran 468s; identical cfg except seed -> est ~470-500s, well under the 900s/15min wall (outer_wall_s=1500 hard cap).
